notes: Schedules: Piano › Schedule plays a channel, a playlist or a piece on chosen days at a set time, until an end time or the end, at its own volume. The tablet wakes for it even with the screen off, connects to the piano and starts; a missed start is shown on the page. The web panel edits the same schedules, and a channel's long-press can schedule it. Also: firmware-update progress stays visible in kiosk, and button labels are consistent.
